name: CubingUSA Northwest FMC Championship 2024
information:
[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa2xBIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--740c53d289def878faa5292856a4438109c059dc/image.png)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/pnwcubing)

- This competition is in partnership with [Pacific Northwest Cubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/pnwcubing)

- This competition is a special competition with only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves; we will not be holding any other event. 

- This competition exists to crown the Northwest Champion of FMC for 2024! For a more normal comeptition experience, or additional details, check out [CubingUSA Northwest Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorthwestChampionship2024)

- Podiums and champions from this competition will be recognized at CubingUSA Northwest Championship 2024 during the award ceremony there.

- This competition will take place at different venues across Pacific Northwest. If you are potentially unable to reach these locales, we would highly recommend refraining from registering from this competition.

-  Check out the [Locations Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorthwestFMCChampionship2024#44326-locations) for more details.
